notes: Private pumps: a pump for one job's vehicles, free or on the job's fuel card, no station needed
Private pumps: choose the pump type and brand live, add as many as you want, stand straight on any ground
Private pumps: screen shows the brand and POLICE ONLY with no prices; can blow up and fix themselves
Exports: SetStationOwner(stationId, citizenid) and GetStationOwner(stationId), server only
Admin panel: any station setting within 3 presses, every change says what changed, settings search

Update: replace the folder, keep your configs, replace locales/en.json, restart
